fix(singlestore): make Collate generation idempotent (#8454)

SingleStore's collate_sql wraps the collated expression in a
":> LONGTEXT" cast, since SingleStore does not support setting a
collation for a column in a SELECT query. Reparsing that SQL yields
Collate(this=Cast(...)), and generating again wrapped the expression
in a second cast, adding one more ":> LONGTEXT" on every transpile
pass.

Skip adding the cast when the collated expression is already a cast to
LONGTEXT, so repeated parse -> generate cycles reach a fixed point.
